title: A nullable string whose value is the text "null" reconstructs as null
rationale: reconstructUnionValue decides the null branch with an in-band sentinel test against the string content of a legitimate value, after trim(). Any nullable string field whose payload is the four characters n-u-l-l is destroyed, and so is one with surrounding whitespace. Same class as NP-022: a sentinel with no escape hatch.
catchesBugClass: In-band sentinel collision on the null discriminator. Also catches a regression that widens the test to startsWith or case-insensitive matching.
cannotCatch: Confined to the two-branch nullable path. The 3+-branch path uses the identical test with a different symptom. It also cannot catch the analogous collapse for an enum whose symbol set legitimately contains "null".

predicted.detail: status and padded both reconstruct as null; safe survives, which is what lets the fixture distinguish "the sentinel fires too eagerly" from "all strings are broken". No configuration disables this.
